cross_cutting_checks.check: Generalized substitution carries the trailing context and handles binders without dropping context.
Weakening freshness/distinct-name assumptions are preserved; implementation shadowing is not imported into the formal theorem.
Declarative preservation is not conflated with bidirectional re-synthesis after annotation erasure.
Progress proves immediate value-or-step without a normalization assumption; canonical forms cover the eliminators used.
The normalization/equality theorem remains conditional on all stated metatheoretic hypotheses.
Natrec iteration is an equality/congruence-closure result, not a false literal CBV trace claim for open terms.
Omega non-typability is restricted to ordinary finite simple types and does not overclaim against recursive types.
Localized trust is conditional on an independently implemented sound kernel and does not establish surface-intent preservation.
Curry–Howard claims are scoped to the corresponding constructive proof/term rules.
The dependent threshold is only a limitation of the Volume-I simple-arrow grammar.
